inputs.source_note: per-club inputs from the 2026-11-19 official snapshot (nba2/v7/official.py); game results from the committed official finals captures

home_court.rule: h = sd(home margin) x Phi^-1(measured home win rate)

rho.definition: r(home margin, total points) over committed official finals

walk_forward.train_rule: cut trained on strictly earlier dates only; at least 40 finals before the first prediction

corroboration.note: points-per-game rating from committed finals vs per-100 NetRtg from the advanced page; different units, so only the rank agreement is informative
corroboration.rule: no rescaling is fitted; the two columns are published side by side
